name: arsel
description: Write correct Arsel integrations: transactional email, SMS, WhatsApp and push, events and automations, contacts and campaigns through the API, and client tracking and push through the web, Android and iOS SDKs.

interface.shortDescription: Build on Arsel's API and SDKs, and write the messages
interface.longDescription: Skills for Arsel, the marketing engagement platform for Saudi Arabia. They cover server-side sends of transactional email, SMS, WhatsApp and push; events that trigger automations; contacts, segments and campaigns; the web, Android and iOS SDKs for tracking and push; and writing email, SMS and WhatsApp content in Arabic and English.
defaultPrompt: Send an order confirmation email and SMS through Arsel
Add the Arsel web SDK and identify users on login
Write an Arabic WhatsApp template that Meta will approve
